version_note: The388-call experiment used the preserved original runner; portable source revision was added later and generated no inference. Historical protocol and evidence remain unchanged.
changes: --input-dir accepts flat inputs or replay_inputs/previous_inputs; missing explicit inputs do not silently use another source.
Default lookup prefers bundled internal/evidence/v50/question_ablation/replay_inputs, then legacy workspace inputs.

--model-dir freezes a separately located local export. No weights means offline planning only; run rejects before network and requires a fresh protocol with the model registered. Partial exports fail.
Default output is package-local runs/v50_ablation; frozen output is never overwritten.
limits: A model-free protocol cannot later gain mutable model hashes; prepare a new output with the actual export.
Model files are hashed locally but not authenticated by this harness. Local serving must already exist at the registered endpoint with matching path/T/dtype.
This smoke copy validates standalone preparation and fail-closed run, not a real model rerun or whole FULL-package regression.
